value.rules_markdown:
- One responsibility per module; core types in module-local types.rs; each port is one trait in one file.
- Every CLI subcommand is declared even when its milestone has not landed, to maintain a stable script surface.
- Presets are data, not code; adding a preset is a new folder, never a new module.
- Never edit vendor/tinyagents here; change it upstream and bump the pin.
- One documentation file per src module in docs/modules/<module>/README.md.
- Examples are declared explicitly in Cargo.toml with required-features so credential-needing smoke tests never build in CI.
- Default build is offline; network access must be gated behind a feature flag (harness, github, serve).
- Use rustfmt formatting and Rust 2024 idioms; snake_case for modules and files, PascalCase for types.
- Return Result<T> using the crate error type from src/error.rs.
- Every file opens with a //! module doc describing its role and any feature gating.
- Comments explain the decision, not the code; load-bearing flags and orderings must say so and why.
- Public items carry doc comments; Clap fields use /// so it becomes help text.
- Tests live in-crate: a #[cfg(test)] mod tests block at the bottom, or sibling test.rs when large; no tests/ directory.
- Every port has an always-compiled offline mock; MockForge records what would have been written for assertions.
- Lane behaviour is covered by golden tests: fixture diff plus canned model response, asserting findings after filtering, dedupe, capping.
- Maintain at least 80% coverage for meaningful library behaviour.
- Keep every Markdown file at 500 lines or fewer; split into focused files and link when exceeding.
- Model never holds a write token; write credentials minted only in src/apply/ after all model calls returned.
- Contributor code is never executed; we do not build, install dependencies, or run the target repository's scripts.
- Pull request bodies, comments, and diffs are untrusted input; fence and label them as data in prompts.
- Secrets found by scanners are reported by type and location only; the value never reaches comments, check-run summaries, or logs.
